name: Park Hyatt Paris-Vendome
positioning: Hotel on Rue de la Paix, steps from Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier, with Korean and contemporary French restaurants and a La Mer spa
best_for: Travelers who want a central Paris base steps from Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier
Food lovers interested in Korean and contemporary French cuisine
Spa-goers who like La Mer treatments

facts.text: The hotel is at 5 Rue de la Paix, 75002 Paris.
Place Vendome and the Opera Garnier are steps from the hotel.
SEOK serves Korean cuisine inspired by the traditions and hospitality of Seoul.
PUR', led by chef Jean-Francois Rouquette, offers contemporary French cuisine with an exclusive Chef's Table experience.
The spa has a jetted tub, a sauna, a steam room and treatment rooms including one for couples.
All rooms were updated in 2017 by American designer Ed Tuttle in a warm neutral and gold palette.
Deluxe rooms have limestone bathrooms with a deep soaking tub and a separate rainfall shower.
Perfumer Christophe Laudamiel created the hotel's signature scent.
L'Appartement is a private apartment with a view over the roofs of Paris.
Cafe Jeanne serves an all-day menu at the bar, by the fireplace or on the terrace.
Opera metro station, served by lines 3, 7 and 8, is nearby.
The hotel has nearly 700 square meters of meeting and event space.

highlights.text: Restaurant PUR' was redesigned by artist-architect Hugo Toro in fall 2024.
The spa partners exclusively with the La Mer cosmetics brand.
Hairstylist John Nollet runs a hair salon in Suite 101 of the hotel.
Sixth-floor rooms have balconies with views of Parisian rooftops and Place Vendome.
La Terrasse du Park is a sunlit terrace in the heart of the hotel, sheltered by historic facades.

considerations.text: Pets are welcome for a daily fee, but not in Restaurant PUR' or the spa.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's premium positioning.
WhataHotel notes the intimate boutique size may limit amenity variety.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Park Hyatt Paris-Vendome
